data.action: 娇羞地侧倚在温润的柏木汤桶边沿，单手轻挽被水汽沾湿的银白短发，修长白皙的双肩与精致锁骨浮出水面，绯红微颤的精灵尖耳在水汽中若隐若现
data.camera: cowboy shot, intimate eye-level view, resting against cedar tub rim, delicate bare shoulders and collarbone visible
data.description: 新婚宅邸的木质汤浴间里，希露菲把身子沉进温热的汤水，只露出一双尖尖的精灵耳——耳朵尖已经被热气熏成了绯红色。她羞得把脸埋进水里咕嘟咕嘟冒泡，半晌才探出脑袋，红着脸小声说——「……水温、水温刚刚好！不是害羞！真的不是！」
data.lighting: warm wooden bathhouse lantern glow, rising steam, soft firelight reflections
data.location: 格雷拉特家木质汤浴间
data.promptProse: Sylphiette rests delicately against the rim of a warm wooden bath, her slender bare shoulders and flushed collarbone gleaming above the steaming water. One hand gently brushes back her damp silver hair as her pointed elf ears blush crimson from the soothing heat, soft lantern light casting amber ripples across the water.
data.title: 希露菲叶特 · 格雷拉特家的初汤
data.animaCaption: Sylphiette leans softly against the wooden tub rim, her bare shoulders and flushed elf ears glowing in the warm lantern steam.
